note: Streak: a habit tracker. Habits on a schedule (every day, some weekdays or n times a week), in categories, with a goal and a reminder; tick them, click heatmap days to change them, read the charts, the day-by-day history with a note per day, the notes and the year's statistics. In English, Italian and Arabic, light or dark, by keyboard or mouse, with commands, a palette and an optional sync through the document server. Habits, the heatmap, the notes and the settings are kept on disk (persist).

notes.text: Started a new book. Twenty pages feels small, which is the point.
Missed it again. Moving it to right after the run, so one habit leads to the other.
Left the phone in the kitchen and read instead. Slept before eleven.
A month without a gap. Next: write the tests first, then the code.
Rain all morning, so a slow walk at lunch instead. It still counts.
Finished the chapter on move semantics. Twelve days in a row now, the longest run since the summer.

dayNotes.1791979200000: Slow day: only the walk and the book.

computed.shown: {{filter(map(state.habits, merge(it, {h: index, due: computed.due[index]})), state.category == '' || it.category == state.category)}}
computed.history: {{map(range(137), {id: text(index), cells: [formatDate(state.now - index * 86400000, 'EEE d MMM', 'utc') + (state.dayNotes[text(state.now - index * 86400000)] ? '  •' : ''), index, floor((136 - index) / 7) + 1, t('doneOf', {done: state.weeks[floor((136 - index) / 7)][(136 - index) % 7], total: length(state.habits)}), state.weeks[floor((136 - index) / 7)][(136 - index) % 7] * 20 + '%']})}}
computed.historyColumns: {{[{id: 'day', title: t('col.day'), width: 320}, {id: 'ago', title: t('col.ago'), width: 220}, {id: 'week', title: t('col.week'), width: 200}, {id: 'done', title: t('col.done'), width: 260}, {id: 'score', title: t('col.score'), width: 180}]}}
computed.goals: {{map(state.habits, {name: it.name, color: it.color, goal: it.goal ?? 7, period: it.period ?? 'week', done: (it.period ?? 'week') == 'week' ? it.weekDone ?? 0 : it.monthDone ?? 0})}}
computed.weekdays: {{[sum(map(state.weeks, it[0])), sum(map(state.weeks, it[1])), sum(map(state.weeks, it[2])), sum(map(state.weeks, it[3])), sum(map(state.weeks, it[4])), sum(map(state.weeks, it[5])), sum(map(state.weeks, it[6]))]}}
computed.draftValid: {{state.draft.reminder == '' || (length(state.draft.reminder) == 5 && slice(state.draft.reminder, 2, 3) == ':' && every(split(slice(state.draft.reminder, 0, 2) + slice(state.draft.reminder, 3, 5), ''), contains('0123456789', it)) && number(slice(state.draft.reminder, 0, 2)) < 24 && number(slice(state.draft.reminder, 3, 5)) < 60)}}
computed.palette: {{map(filter(commands, it.enabled && it.name != 'commandPalette'), {title: t('cmd.' + it.name), detail: it.keyLabel ?? '', run: it.name})}}
computed.syncData: {{ {habits: state.habits, weeks: state.weeks, notes: state.notes, dayNotes: state.dayNotes} }}
computed.syncText: {{computed.syncState == 'error' ? t('sync.error', {message: state.sync.error}) : state.sync.commits > 0 ? t('sync.commits', {state: t('sync.' + computed.syncState), n: state.sync.commits}) : t('sync.' + computed.syncState)}}
